question.text: For the angle of minimum deviation of a prism to be equal to its refracting angle, the prism must be made of a material whose refractive index:

solution.text: The angle of minimum deviation is given as $$ \delta_{\min }=i+e-A $$ for minimum deviation $$ \begin{aligned} \delta_{\min } &=A \text { then } \\ 2 A &=i+e \end{aligned} $$ in case of $\delta_{\min } i=e$ $$ \begin{aligned} 2 A &=2 i \quad r_{1}=r_{2}=\frac{A}{2} \\ i &=A=90^{\circ} \end{aligned} $$ from smell's law $$ \begin{array}{l} 1 \sin i=n \sin r_{1} \\ \sin A=n \sin \frac{A}{2} \\ 2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{A}{2}=n \sin \frac{A}{2} \\ 2 \cos \frac{A}{2}=n \end{array} $$ $$ \begin{array}{l} \text { when } \quad A=90^{\circ}=i_{\min } \\ \text { then } \quad n_{\min }=\sqrt{2} \\ i=A=0 \quad n_{\max }=2 \end{array} $$
